Practice Area

Civil Litigation

Assertive representation in contract, recovery and declaratory disputes.

Discuss Your Matter+91 98111 35465

Overview

What this area covers

We appear in civil suits before trial courts, District Courts, the High Court and appellate forums in matters ranging from breach of contract and money recovery to specific performance, injunctions, partition and declaratory relief.

Civil litigation in India rewards preparation and punishes drift. We invest heavily in pleadings and documentary groundwork at the outset, because a well-framed plaint or written statement shapes every hearing that follows — and frequently produces a settlement on better terms than a judgment would.

Services Offered

What we handle within civil litigation

01

Suits for recovery of money and damages

02

Breach of contract and specific performance claims

03

Injunctions, stay applications and interim relief

04

Partition, declaration and possession suits

05

Execution of decrees and enforcement proceedings

06

Civil appeals, revisions and writ petitions

Our Process

How a matter proceeds

Four stages, each with a defined output — so you always know what has happened and what comes next.

01

Case assessment

We review your documents against limitation, jurisdiction and cause of action, and tell you candidly how strong the claim is before you commit to it.

02

Notice and settlement attempt

A properly drafted legal notice resolves a meaningful share of disputes. Where it does not, it strengthens the record for the suit that follows.

03

Pleadings and interim relief

We file the plaint or written statement with a complete documentary compilation, and move immediately for interim protection where assets or possession are at risk.

04

Trial, judgment and execution

We conduct evidence and arguments, and follow through on execution — a decree that is never enforced is not a result.

Benefits

What instructing us gets you

These are commitments, not aspirations. If we fail one of them on your matter, tell the partner handling it.

  • Honest merits assessment before you incur litigation costs

  • Interim relief pursued early to protect assets and possession

  • Written hearing updates after every listed date

  • Execution handled as part of the mandate, not as an afterthought
